groups.title: Dead code
groups.blurb: Exports and files nothing in the product uses, found by the dead-code sweep and confirmed by reading the code.

findings.title: isCommonPassword is used nowhere
findings.summary: `isCommonPassword` in the core's common-password module has no reference but its declaration (`git grep -n isCommonPassword`): every caller asks `commonRank` instead, which also gives the rank that Strength reads.
findings.action: Delete the export, or keep it for the core package's public API (EP-M1.1) and export it from there.
